```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(EcolUtils)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)

source(here("R/utils.R"))

# Create RDS output directory if it doesn't exist
dir.create(RDS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load raw count and taxonomy data

```{r load-counts}
data <- read.table(
  here::here("data", "count_table.txt"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
)

genus_data <- read.table(
  here::here("data", "GTDB_Genus_abundance_table.tsv"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
)

# Fix column names: replace first two dots with hyphens
colnames(data)       <- sub("\\.", "-", sub("\\.", "-", colnames(data)))
colnames(genus_data) <- sub("\\.", "-", sub("\\.", "-", colnames(genus_data)))

data       <- column_to_rownames(data,       "genomeID")
genus_data <- column_to_rownames(genus_data, "genus")
```

```{r load-taxonomy}
# Database metadata: maps internal genome IDs to public IDs, genera, etc.
dbmd <- read.table(file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "curto_core_genesDB/masterMD4DB.txt"))
rownames(data) <- dbmd$V4[match(rownames(data), dbmd$V5)]

# Build taxonomy table: genus / clade / subclade
tax <- data.frame(genomeID = rownames(data))
tax$genus <- dbmd$V1[match(tax$genomeID, dbmd$V4)]

master_md <- read.table(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "isolates/master_md_all_sequenced_Isolates_with_extendedMD.txt"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
)
tax <- merge(tax, master_md[, c(2, 3, 9)], by.x = "genomeID", by.y = "Name", all.x = TRUE)
tax <- as.matrix(column_to_rownames(tax, "genomeID"))
```

```{r load-clade-colors}
mapping_colors <- read.table(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "isolates/clade_colors.txt"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", comment.char = ""
)
mapping_colors <- mapping_colors[-c(1:7), ]

clds <- c("I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "UND")
clade_colors <- setNames(
  mapping_colors[match(clds, mapping_colors$variable), 2],
  mapping_colors[match(clds, mapping_colors$variable), 1]
)

subclds <- mapping_colors$variable[!mapping_colors$variable %in% clds]
subclade_colors <- setNames(
  mapping_colors[mapping_colors$variable %in% subclds, 2],
  mapping_colors[mapping_colors$variable %in% subclds, 1]
)

# Build subclade color vector for bar plots (with transparent "Clade X" headers)
subclade_colors_bp <- c(
  "Clade I"   = "transparent",
  "IA"  = subclade_colors[["IA"]],  "IB"  = subclade_colors[["IB"]],  "IC"  = subclade_colors[["IC"]],
  "Clade II"  = "transparent",
  "IIA" = subclade_colors[["IIA"]], "IIB" = subclade_colors[["IIB"]], "IIC" = subclade_colors[["IIC"]],
  "IID" = subclade_colors[["IID"]], "IIE" = subclade_colors[["IIE"]], "IIF" = subclade_colors[["IIF"]],
  "IIG" = subclade_colors[["IIG"]], "IIH" = subclade_colors[["IIH"]], "IIJ" = subclade_colors[["IIJ"]],
  "IIK" = subclade_colors[["IIK"]],
  "Clade III" = "transparent",
  "IIIA" = subclade_colors[["IIIA"]], "IIIB" = subclade_colors[["IIIB"]],
  "IIIC" = subclade_colors[["IIIC"]], "IIID" = subclade_colors[["IIID"]],
  "IIIE" = subclade_colors[["IIIE"]], "IIIF" = subclade_colors[["IIIF"]],
  "Clade IV"  = "transparent",
  "IVA" = subclade_colors[["IVA"]], "IVB" = subclade_colors[["IVB"]],
  "IVC" = subclade_colors[["IVC"]], "IVD" = subclade_colors[["IVD"]], "IVE" = subclade_colors[["IVE"]],
  "Clade V"   = "transparent",
  "VA"  = subclade_colors[["VA"]]
)
```

## Load and process metadata

```{r load-metadata}
metadata <- read.table(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "RTs/RTs_sample_metadata.txt"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = ""
)

reserve_names <- unique(metadata$Reserve)
codenames     <- c("EMR", "MOJ", "COP", "SGWK", "BLOK", "BOMR", "McLL", "SNARL", "LOMA")
reserve_codenames <- data.frame(
  ReserveName = reserve_names,
  CodeName    = codenames,
  color       = reserve_colors
)

metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(
    reserve_code = reserve_codenames$CodeName[match(Reserve,           reserve_codenames$ReserveName)],
    s_code       = reserve_codenames$CodeName[match(Substrate_reserve, reserve_codenames$ReserveName)],
    i_code       = case_when(
      Inoculum_reserve == "none" ~ "none",
      TRUE ~ reserve_codenames$CodeName[match(Inoculum_reserve, reserve_codenames$ReserveName)]
    ),
    r_home = case_when(
      Inoculum == "IX"               ~ "none",
      Inoculum_reserve == Reserve    ~ "home",
      TRUE                           ~ "away"
    ),
    s_home = case_when(
      Inoculum_reserve != "none" & Substrate_reserve == Reserve  ~ "home",
      Inoculum_reserve != "none" & Substrate_reserve != Reserve  ~ "away",
      Inoculum_reserve == "none" & Substrate_reserve == Reserve  ~ "home",
      TRUE                                                         ~ "away"
    ),
    i_home = case_when(
      Inoculum == "IX"             ~ "none",
      Reserve == Inoculum_reserve  ~ "home",
      TRUE                         ~ "away"
    )
  ) |>
  unite(col = "treatment", c(Bag_type, s_home, i_home),
        sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) |>
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c(
    "Closed_home_home", "Closed_home_away", "Closed_away_home", "Closed_away_away",
    "Closed_home_none", "Closed_away_none", "Open_away_none",   "Open_home_none"
  ))) |>
  group_by(reserve_code, Bag_type, s_code, i_code) |>
  mutate(replicate = factor(row_number())) |>
  ungroup() |>
  unite(col = "treatment_rep", c(treatment, replicate),
        sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) |>
  unite(col = "treatment_2", c(reserve_code, s_code, i_code, Bag_type),
        sep = "|", remove = FALSE)

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$original_label
```

## Litter chemistry

```{r litter-chemistry}
litter_chem <- read.table(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "mg/litter_chem/litter_chem.txt"),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", comment.char = ""
) |>
  dplyr::select(-c(1:4, 6:10)) |>
  mutate(sampleID = gsub("^#\\d+\\s+", "", desc_1)) |>
  dplyr::select(-desc_1) |>
  dplyr::select(sampleID, everything()) |>
  filter(sampleID != "SKIP")

# Duplicate rows with new IDs (1→3, 2→4) to account for paired samples
litter_chem <- litter_chem |>
  mutate(new_sampleID = case_when(
    grepl("1$", sampleID) ~ sub("1$", "3", sampleID),
    grepl("2$", sampleID) ~ sub("2$", "4", sampleID),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) |>
  filter(!is.na(new_sampleID)) |>
  bind_rows(
    litter_chem |>
      mutate(sampleID = case_when(
        grepl("1$", sampleID) ~ sub("1$", "3", sampleID),
        grepl("2$", sampleID) ~ sub("2$", "4", sampleID),
        TRUE ~ sampleID
      ))
  ) |>
  arrange(sampleID) |>
  dplyr::select(sampleID, ADF, NDF, CP, Lignin, NFC, NSC) |>
  mutate(
    cellulose        = ADF - Lignin,
    hemicellulose    = pmax(NDF - ADF, 0),
    Structural_Carbohydrates = NFC - NSC
  ) |>
  filter(!sampleID %in% c("0.3", "#97")) |>
  dplyr::select(sampleID, CP, cellulose, hemicellulose, Structural_Carbohydrates, Lignin) |>
  rename(lignin = Lignin, crude_protein = CP)

litt_chem_LOMA <- litter_chem |> filter(sampleID == "0.1")

litter_chem_agg <- litter_chem |>
  filter(sampleID != "0.1") |>
  mutate(sampleID = str_remove(sampleID, "\\d$")) |>
  group_by(sampleID) |>
  summarise(
    crude_protein = mean(crude_protein, na.rm = TRUE),
    cellulose     = mean(cellulose,     na.rm = TRUE),
    hemicellulose = mean(hemicellulose, na.rm = TRUE),
    lignin        = mean(lignin,        na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  bind_rows(litt_chem_LOMA) |>
  select(-Structural_Carbohydrates) |>
  mutate(sampleID = if_else(sampleID == "0.1", "LOMA", sampleID))

# PCA of litter chemistry; compute Euclidean distances to LOMA
pca_litt  <- prcomp(litter_chem_agg |> column_to_rownames("sampleID"), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
litt_dist <- as.matrix(dist(pca_litt$x))

reserve_ids <- c("23", "26", "32", "35", "02", "08", "11", "36")
litt_dists_toLOMA <- litt_dist |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("reserve") |>
  filter(reserve %in% paste0(reserve_ids, "D")) |>
  dplyr::select(reserve, LOMA) |>
  rename(euc_litt_dist = LOMA) |>
  mutate(reserve_code = case_when(
    grepl("^02", reserve) ~ "BLOK",  grepl("^23", reserve) ~ "EMR",
    grepl("^26", reserve) ~ "MOJ",   grepl("^32", reserve) ~ "COP",
    grepl("^35", reserve) ~ "SGWK",  grepl("^08", reserve) ~ "BOMR",
    grepl("^11", reserve) ~ "McLL",  grepl("^36", reserve) ~ "SNARL",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) |>
  left_join(
    litter_chem_agg |>
      filter(sampleID %in% c(paste0(reserve_ids, "D"), "LOMA")) |>
      left_join(
        pca_litt$x |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column("sampleID") |>
          filter(sampleID %in% c(paste0(reserve_ids, "D"), "LOMA")) |>
          select(sampleID, PC1, PC2),
        by = "sampleID"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        PC1_LOMA_litt_dist           = abs(PC1[sampleID == "LOMA"] - PC1),
        PC2_LOMA_litt_dist           = abs(PC2[sampleID == "LOMA"] - PC2),
        PCsLOMA_litt_dist            = sqrt((PC1 - PC1[sampleID == "LOMA"])^2 +
                                            (PC2 - PC2[sampleID == "LOMA"])^2),
        CP_LOMA_litt_dist            = abs(crude_protein[sampleID == "LOMA"] - crude_protein),
        cellulose_LOMA_litt_dist     = abs(cellulose[sampleID == "LOMA"]     - cellulose),
        hemicellulose_LOMA_litt_dist = abs(hemicellulose[sampleID == "LOMA"] - hemicellulose),
        lignin_LOMA_litt_dist        = abs(lignin[sampleID == "LOMA"]        - lignin)
      ) |>
      filter(sampleID != "LOMA"),
    by = c("reserve" = "sampleID")
  ) |>
  mutate(pair = paste(reserve_code, "vs", "LOMA")) |>
  select(-reserve)
```

## Normalize count table by total gene lengths

```{r normalize-counts}
gene_lengths_by_genome <- read.table(
  file.path(CA_CURTO_ROOT, "curto_core_genesDB/gene_lengths_by_genome.csv"),
  row.names = 1, header = TRUE, sep = ",", check.names = FALSE
)
colnames(gene_lengths_by_genome) <- dbmd$V4[match(colnames(gene_lengths_by_genome), dbmd$V3)]

# Report any mismatches between the count table and gene-length table
missing_in_gene_lengths <- setdiff(rownames(data), colnames(gene_lengths_by_genome))
missing_in_counts       <- setdiff(colnames(gene_lengths_by_genome), rownames(data))
cat("Genomes missing in gene_lengths:\n"); print(missing_in_gene_lengths)
cat("Genomes missing in counts:\n");      print(missing_in_counts)

data <- data[!rownames(data) %in% missing_in_gene_lengths, ]

total_gene_lengths <- colSums(gene_lengths_by_genome)[rownames(data)]
stopifnot(all.equal(names(total_gene_lengths), rownames(data)))

rpk_table <- round(sweep(data, 1, total_gene_lengths, FUN = "/") * 1e6)
cat("Sample library sizes (RPK):\n"); sort(colSums(rpk_table))

# Sync metadata rownames after any sample drops
missing_samples <- union(
  setdiff(rownames(metadata), colnames(rpk_table)),
  setdiff(colnames(rpk_table), rownames(metadata))
)
if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  message("Dropping ", length(missing_samples), " samples with no match: ",
          paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", "))
  metadata <- metadata |> filter(!rownames(metadata) %in% missing_samples)
}
```

## Build phyloseq objects

```{r build-phyloseq}
count_table <- otu_table(rpk_table, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
taxonomy    <- tax_table(tax)
sam_data    <- sample_data(metadata)
sample_names(sam_data) <- metadata$original_label

rt <- phyloseq(count_table, taxonomy, sam_data)
rt

# Genus-level phyloseq (no taxonomy table needed — OTU names are genera)
genus_count_table <- otu_table(genus_data, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
rt_g <- phyloseq(genus_count_table, sam_data)
rt_g
```

## Rarefaction

```{r rarefaction}
set.seed(SEED)

# --- Full community ---
rar_table <- data.frame(
  t(rrarefy.perm(data.frame(t(rt@otu_table)),
                 sample = RAREFY_DEPTH_ALL, n = N_ITER, round.out = TRUE))
)
rar_table <- rar_table[rowSums(rar_table) != 0, ]
colnames(rar_table) <- sub("\\.", "-", sub("\\.", "-", colnames(rar_table)))
rownames(rar_table) <- gsub("\\.", "-", sub("X", "", rownames(rar_table)))

rt_rar <- phyloseq(
  sample_data(rt@sam_data),
  otu_table(as.matrix(rar_table), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(rt@tax_table)
)

# --- Curtobacterium only ---
rtB4rar <- subset_taxa(rt, genus == "Curtobacterium")
cat("Curtobacterium library sizes:\n"); sort(sample_sums(rtB4rar))

rar_table_curto <- data.frame(
  t(rrarefy.perm(data.frame(t(rtB4rar@otu_table)),
                 sample = RAREFY_DEPTH_CURTO, n = N_ITER, round.out = TRUE))
)
rar_table_curto <- rar_table_curto[rowSums(rar_table_curto) != 0, ]
colnames(rar_table_curto) <- sub("\\.", "-", sub("\\.", "-", colnames(rar_table_curto)))
rownames(rar_table_curto) <- gsub("\\.", "-", sub("X", "", rownames(rar_table_curto)))

rt_curto_rar <- phyloseq(
  sample_data(rt@sam_data),
  otu_table(as.matrix(rar_table_curto), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(rt@tax_table)
)

# --- Genus level ---
genus_min_sample <- min(sample_sums(rt_g))
cat("Minimum genus-level library size:", genus_min_sample, "\n")

g_rar_table <- data.frame(
  t(rrarefy.perm(data.frame(t(rt_g@otu_table)),
                 sample = genus_min_sample, n = N_ITER, round.out = TRUE))
)
g_rar_table <- g_rar_table[rowSums(g_rar_table) != 0, ]
colnames(g_rar_table) <- sub("\\.", "-", sub("\\.", "-", colnames(g_rar_table)))

rt_g_rar <- phyloseq(
  sample_data(rt_g@sam_data),
  otu_table(as.matrix(g_rar_table), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
)

# Derived unrarefied OTU tables used as inputs to calc_alpha_diversity / avgdist
curto_unrar_otutab           <- as.data.frame(t(rtB4rar@otu_table))
genus_unrar_otutab           <- as.data.frame(t(rt_g@otu_table))
rt_subclades                 <- tax_glom(rtB4rar, taxrank = "subclade")
curto_subclades_unrar_otutab <- as.data.frame(t(rt_subclades@otu_table))
```

## Treatment summary

```{r treatment-summary}
treatment_summary <- metadata |>
  count(reserve_code, Bag_type, s_code, i_code) |>
  tidyr::complete(reserve_code, Bag_type, s_code, i_code, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  arrange(reserve_code, Bag_type, s_code, i_code)

missing_treatments <- treatment_summary |> filter(n == 0)
cat("Missing treatment combinations:\n"); print(missing_treatments)
```

## Save outputs

```{r save-rds}
saveRDS(rt,                          file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt.rds"))
saveRDS(rt_rar,                      file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_rar.rds"))
saveRDS(rt_g,                        file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_g.rds"))
saveRDS(rt_g_rar,                    file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_g_rar.rds"))
saveRDS(rtB4rar,                     file.path(RDS_DIR, "rtB4rar.rds"))
saveRDS(rt_curto_rar,                file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_curto_rar.rds"))
saveRDS(rt_subclades,                file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_subclades.rds"))
saveRDS(metadata,                    file.path(RDS_DIR, "metadata.rds"))
saveRDS(tax,                         file.path(RDS_DIR, "tax.rds"))
saveRDS(curto_unrar_otutab,          file.path(RDS_DIR, "curto_unrar_otutab.rds"))
saveRDS(genus_unrar_otutab,          file.path(RDS_DIR, "genus_unrar_otutab.rds"))
saveRDS(curto_subclades_unrar_otutab,file.path(RDS_DIR, "curto_subclades_unrar_otutab.rds"))
saveRDS(genus_min_sample,            file.path(RDS_DIR, "genus_min_sample.rds"))
saveRDS(clade_colors,                file.path(RDS_DIR, "clade_colors.rds"))
saveRDS(subclade_colors,             file.path(RDS_DIR, "subclade_colors.rds"))
saveRDS(subclade_colors_bp,          file.path(RDS_DIR, "subclade_colors_bp.rds"))
saveRDS(subclds,                     file.path(RDS_DIR, "subclds.rds"))
saveRDS(litter_chem_agg,             file.path(RDS_DIR, "litter_chem_agg.rds"))
saveRDS(litt_dists_toLOMA,           file.path(RDS_DIR, "litt_dists_toLOMA.rds"))

message("01_data_load: all objects saved to ", RDS_DIR)
```
